student-fortress-open-reserve-template-v.interpretation: Finite-cohort A-minus-B bounds, not confidence intervals. Error prefixes remain unscored in official standings; their unknown scores range independently over [0,1] only for this sensitivity calculation.

complete_case_direction_diagnostic.interpretation: Sign symmetry diagnostic on complete-case pair directions; ties ignored. Not a test of the mean effect, not adjusted for campaign multiple comparisons or selection.
